conventions.order: Sections are in display order (SECTION_ORDER). Fields are in render order within a section.
conventions.paths: Dot paths into the stored record. A field with path null is display-only (type computed). Keys of mapByKey rows may themselves contain dots or spaces (e.g. assessment.conditions['lighting.console'], disciplines.curtain.items['Main / act curtain']) — treat a row key as ONE object key.
conventions.rules: truthy = a non-blank string (after trim), true, a non-zero number, a non-empty array or a non-empty object. eq compares deeply (eq: ["None"] means the array is exactly that one item; the code compares 'none' case-insensitively). includes tests array membership. A hidden field or section KEEPS its stored value — hiding never clears.
conventions.scopeRule: `scope` counts as answered only when it holds at least one of rigging / curtain / lighting / av; unanswered filters nothing.
conventions.visibleWhen vs enabledWhen: visibleWhen hides. enabledWhen (the four discipline sections) leaves the section listed but locked shut until the rule holds.
conventions.options: A list name refers to `lists`. List items are plain strings, or { value, label } where the stored value differs from the label. An object { source: … } means the options come from live data (directory, roster, settings).
conventions.selects: Every select starts with a blank '— Select —' option, and a stored value outside its list is still shown as an extra option and kept.
conventions.feetInches: Measurement inputs are FREE TEXT stored as typed ("38'-6\"", "38.5", "38 ft", or words). Nothing validates or converts them on entry. Several quick-set keys are descriptive rather than dimensions (structure, clearSpan, floorCondition, obstructions, seating, seatingConfig, pitDesc, pinRail, loadingGallery, bleacherType, columnSpacing, rigPointCapacity, roomCapacity, doorCount, catwalkCount, doorMainWH, boothWD) — that classification is the spec author's reading; the code draws them all with the same input.
conventions.boolean in measurements: measurements holds booleans for the check fields (structuralDrawingOnFile, brickDrawingOnFile, cwElevationOnFile, loadingBridge) beside strings.
conventions.rows: storage 'array' = an array of row objects (each with an id); 'mapByKey' = an object keyed by row label/key; 'string[]' = a list of strings. rowKeys says where a mapByKey's rows come from; rowFilter says which rows of a shared array a field owns.
conventions.slider: The condition slider stores 0–4 (Bad, Poor, Fair, Good, New). Never rated = key absent (shows a ghost 'Not rated' track with a Rate button that sets 2). Clear stores null, which must be kept as null (it means 'cleared', not 'never rated').
conventions.photos: Every section with photos: true has an Add photo button in its header (not while a discipline is locked). Photos are stored in the one top-level photoRefs array, each tagged with the section key.
conventions.olderNotes: Every section may show a read-only 'Older notes (N)' fold at its foot: the derived legacyNotes whose `section` equals the section key.
conventions.collapse: collapsedByDefault sections start shut; the open/shut choice is remembered per viewer per record (local storage key va:collapsed:<id>).

fields.label: How many line sets?
fields.help: Whole number, clamped 0–200. Committing it makes rows numbered 1…N: existing rows keep their ids, missing numbers get blank rows, empty rows above N go silently, rows above N that hold data need a Confirm ('Remove sets 12–14? They have information entered.'). Blank commits as 0. Always stored as a number once touched.

fields.label: Line sets
fields.help: Shown sorted by set number (whole number ≥ 1), unnumbered rows last. Type options print as '<code> — <label>'. A row can be removed only when its number is above the quantity, it has no usable number, or no quantity is set; removing a row with data asks to confirm. Tools: Fill down (copy one column from the focused row to every row below, confirming when it would replace values), Mark range spare (sets from–to with no type become 'O'), and add the missing sets 1…quantity. The legacy `cond` code (G/F/P/X) stays stored and seeds `condition` once (G 3, F 2, P 1, X 0). Any row edit, or a quantity above 0, sets linesetsEnabled true.
